claims: Arizona State University is a public research university in metro Phoenix.
Arizona State University has been ranked the #1 most innovative school for 10 consecutive years.
Arizona State University has an 89.9% acceptance rate.
U.S. News & World Report ranks Arizona State University #1 in innovation.
Many Arizona State University online master's programs range from $18,000 to $30,000.
Arizona State University has students from over 150 countries.
Arizona State University features multiple locations.
Arizona State University's main historic campus is in Tempe.
